issues.currentImplementation: 机械扫描 73 个组件目录，69 个在公开 Props 里声明 className / rootClassName（部分还有 style）作为根节点别名，并在实现里手动拼接。这与 COMPATIBILITY.md §7（React className→Vue 原生 class、style→原生 style）系统冲突：根 class/style 应走 $attrs。
issues.semanticDifference: Vue 单根组件默认自动透传 class/style/attrs；显式声明根别名既重复又与原生 attrs 语义打架，且会诱导用户写出 React 写法。多根 / inheritAttrs:false 的组件还需要显式 mergeProps 才能保证 attrs 落到正确根。
issues.recommendation: 作为系统性问题统一处理：单根组件删除根别名 Props（Vue 自动透传即可）；多根或 inheritAttrs:false 的组件改用 render 期 mergeProps 合并「内部类 + 实时 $attrs」；有独立目标（如浮层 / 子节点）的 className/style 保留并逐条登记理由。Provider 配置对象（ComponentStyleConfig）的 className/style 不在此列，保留。
issues.verification: 机械扫描 69/73 命中。已迁移并各自提交（33 个）：button、divider、flex、alert、breadcrumb、avatar、back-top、card、descriptions、anchor、carousel、app、calendar、badge、dropdown、space、grid、layout、tag、skeleton、result、statistic、typography、watermark、spin、empty、radio、switch、splitter、qr-code、listy、progress、rate。每个都跑 unit/dom-contract/types 全绿。保留为独立目标：border-beam、anchor items[]、carousel 内层 slick-slider、badge.style、ribbon.className/style、dropdown.rootClassName、descriptions item 级、avatar group max/popover、skeleton Node 内层、tag CheckableTagOption、typography InternalTypography 内部通道、radio option、splitter Panel、qr-code 的 QrCodeComponentConfig。阻塞：auto-complete 需先做 select。

issues.title: 根别名迁移的内部消费者连带：className/rootClassName 静默丢失类名
issues.detail: 组件迁移后，仓内其他组件仍以 className/rootClassName 调用它 ⇒ 这些键不再是 props ⇒ 落进 attrs ⇒ 类名静默丢失（form 一次红 19 条 L4 用例）。已逐处改为原生 class。
issues.verification: 累计修 12 处：form/FormItemInput+FormItemLabel → Col；float-button/FloatButtonGroup → Flex/SpaceCompact、FloatButton → Badge；input-number/InputNumber → SpaceAddon/SpaceCompact；modal/Modal → Skeleton；statistic/Timer → Statistic；config-provider/default-render-empty → Empty；calendar/components/CalendarHeader → RadioGroup；radio/Group → Radio；image/Image + notification/engine/Notice → Progress。误报排除：modal/engine/Dialog 的 Content、table/use-filter 的 FilterWrapper、Dropdown.rootClassName、transfer/Actions 与 CalendarHeader 自身的 props 声明。

sessionLog.note: Created and validated vue-native-audit Skill; initialized component/surface inventory. Full audit and refactor remain in progress.

Persisted first-batch evidence: 17/24 component source reviews complete, 7 partial, 130/955 production source files reviewed; registered 8 open findings (P1=3, P2=5). No product code changed and no tests run.

Started next component batch with a focused shared-renderer probe: 11 import sites across 7 component directories consume the VNodeChild renderer from empty/components; Spin has a duplicate. Recorded P0 architecture finding VNA-RENDERER-01 while explicitly retaining the Vue-specific renderer abstraction. Empty and Spin each have 3/7 and 3/11 source files reviewed.

Affix sample refactor implemented. Removed production [affix-probe] console logging; added hasSameFixedPosition to compare Vue inline px strings in the RAF fast path; added component regression test and unit cases, updated Chinese/English docs and README. Focused unit: 2 files / 19 tests passed; targeted Biome passed; full vue-tsc still pending. Issues VNA-AFFIX-01/02 marked fixed subject to type-check completion; Affix component audit status testing.

Affix one-component pilot is verified: all 6 production files reviewed, two findings fixed, focused unit 2 files/19 tests pass, repo-wide vue-tsc exits 0, targeted Biome and git diff --check pass. Added explicit Affix component regression test and synced README + zh/en docs. Other components and shared surfaces remain pending.

User caught an audit miss in Affix: className/rootClassName/style remained in AffixProps. Cross-check found this contradicted COMPATIBILITY.md §7 (className→native class; style→native style); rootClassName was declared but not consumed at runtime. Reopened Affix as refactoring; added VNA-AFFIX-03. Keeping AffixConfig.className/style because these are ConfigProvider object schema, not component props. Skill now has mandatory mapping-reconciliation and native-attrs type-test gates.

API correction checks completed: moved React className baseline expectation onto Vue native class, removed className/rootClassName/style from AffixProps, kept ConfigProvider AffixConfig className/style, and merged provider defaults with live attrs at render time. Focused unit 21/21, dom-contract 11/11, type project 30/30 (no type errors), targeted Biome and diff-check all pass. Full repo vue-tsc is running.

Affix contract miss fully corrected. Removed className/rootClassName/style from AffixProps, kept AffixConfig.className/style solely as ConfigProvider schema, switched React className oracle case to Vue class, and changed rootClassName baseline case to no Vue prop. Added type negatives for all removed Props, live attr/update/provider tests, and docs. Skill now mandates mapping reconciliation and separate component-Props vs attrs/config schema review. Verification: unit 21/21, DOM 11/11, types 30/30 (no errors), full lint:types, Biome, diff check pass. Affix done; rest audit remains in progress.

User requested that audit learnings be accumulated. Expanded vue-native-audit Skill with an Affix postmortem: map-contract reconciliation; component Props vs ConfigProvider schema; live useAttrs/mergeProps at render; translating React oracle inputs to Vue API; positive/negative public $props tests; reopening premature done findings. Skill Creator quick validation and repackaging passed; full repo lint:types rerun passed after final Affix type-test changes.

Started Button as the next demonstration after Affix. Registry had Button prematurely marked done from read-only audit; re-opened because interface.ts still exposed className/rootClassName/style against COMPATIBILITY §7. Updating native attrs, contract/type tests, React oracle translation, docs, and preserving ConfigProvider ButtonConfig fields. Tracing consumers including Tour before closing.

Button sample complete and verified. Removed className/rootClassName/style from ButtonProps; root attrs now merge via render-time mergeProps (state+semantic+Provider style then live $attrs) across both <button>/<a> roots; ButtonConfig schema kept. Migrated nested button config bags to native class: TourButtonProps.className→class; ModalButtonProps/PopconfirmButtonProps add class/style and declare className/rootClassName as never (verified never+index-signature rejects). Removed now-dead runtime alias mapping. Gates: unit 188/188, DOM 66/66, types 82/82 no errors, full lint:types exit 0, Biome/diff-check clean. Logged VNA-DROPDOWN-02 (DropdownButton declared className leaks as classname attr) for the dropdown batch. Affix + Button now done; rest pending.

Button L6 visual regression confirmed after `pnpm build:ui`: `tests/visual/run.mjs --component button --mode compare` → 27/27 pass (24 exact, 3 semantic at 0.005–0.021% antialias-noise). Button demo fully verified: unit 188/188, DOM 66/66, types 82/82, full lint:types, L6 27/27, Biome/diff-check.

Library-wide scan found 69/73 components still declaring root alias props (className/rootClassName/style) against COMPATIBILITY §7. Recorded as systemic P1 VNA-ROOTALIAS-01. Plan: migrate per component (single-root → delete alias props and rely on Vue fallthrough; multi-root/inheritAttrs:false → render-time mergeProps), verifying and committing one component at a time.

Root-alias migration started. divider migrated first: DividerProps drops className/rootClassName/style; root attrs merged via render-time mergeProps; DividerConfig schema kept. unit 61/61, DOM 54/54, types 32/32 no errors, Biome+diff clean. Committing one component at a time per user instruction.

Root-alias migration: divider + flex done and committed (one commit each). Learned and recorded in the Skill that useComponentConfig() destructured fields are plain values, not refs — writing contextStyle.value throws on every render and fails the whole suite. Next components pending.

Root-alias migration batch 2: alert, breadcrumb, avatar, back-top, card migrated, each committed separately with unit+dom+types green. Two reusable pitfalls recorded in the Skill: (1) an HTML comment sibling of the root element in <template> silently makes the component multi-root and disables attrs fallthrough; (2) leftover React className keys are no longer props, fall into attrs and override the root class. Total migrated so far: button, divider, flex, alert, breadcrumb, avatar, back-top, card.

Root-alias migration batch 3: descriptions, anchor, carousel, app, calendar migrated and committed separately (13 components total). Notable: anchor needed inheritAttrs:false to bind attrs to the INNER wrapper (not the outer Affix); carousel/calendar roots intentionally accept only class/style because upstream does not spread restProps (L4 carousel:attrs/calendar:attrs prove it); anchor items[] className is a data field on a shared base type and stays. auto-complete is blocked on select (its className is forwarded to Select.className).

Root-alias migration batch 4: badge, dropdown, space, grid, layout migrated (18 components total). Key pitfall found: writing `class: <array>` AFTER `...attrs` in an object literal silently replaces the caller class entirely (L4 caught it on Layout/Sider) - attrs.class must be pushed into the array instead. Also removed DropdownButtonProps.className which fixes VNA-DROPDOWN-02 (React key leaking into the DOM as a classname attribute).

Root-alias migration batch 5: tag, skeleton, result, statistic migrated (22 components total). New P1 issue VNA-ROOTALIAS-02 found and fixed: internal consumers still passing className/rootClassName to migrated components silently lose the class (Form->Col broke 19 L4 cases at once). A reusable repo-wide scan script is now in the Skill and must be run after every batch. Also learned: collapsing className+rootClassName into one class key can create a duplicate-key lint error; merge into an array preserving clsx order.

Root-alias migration batch 6: typography, watermark, spin, empty migrated (26 components total). Two more pitfalls recorded: (1) leaving attrs.style inside a trailing {...attrs} spread silently overrides the computed style key (Typography lost WebkitLineClamp); (2) adding attrs.class to rootClass when the template already has v-bind="rootAttrs" renders the caller class twice (Spin/Empty). Rule: render-function components must push attrs.class in; template components with v-bind must not. The internal-consumer scan caught one more: config-provider default Empty render.

Root-alias migration batch 7: radio, switch, splitter migrated (29 components total). The consumer scan caught two more: calendar/components/CalendarHeader passing className to RadioGroup, and radio/Group forwarding option.className to Radio. Both would have silently dropped classes. SplitterPanel/InternalPanel className/style intentionally kept - Panel is renderless and its props are a data-collection channel.

Root-alias migration batch 8: qr-code, listy migrated (31 components total). Notable: both had a NON-obvious coupling - qr-code read props.style.width/height to derive the canvas size, and listy Virtual branch relied on the semantic list to carry props.style into mergedStyles.root. Removing the props silently broke those two paths; both now read attrs.style explicitly. Lesson: always grep for props.style usages beyond the class array, and check every render branch.

Root-alias migration batch 9: progress migrated (32 components total). The consumer scan caught two more (image/Image placeholder Progress, notification Notice progress bar). Pitfall: Progress declared `style` TWICE in runtime props (one as [Object, String]) - grepping only `style: { type` missed it. Skill updated with the post-edit grep-and-confirm-zero rule.

Root-alias migration batch 10: rate migrated (33 components total). Clean case - no new pitfalls, no new internal consumers. The established checklist (interface + runtime props + class array + every render branch + style usages + consumer scan + docs) handled it end to end.

observations.note: NodeRenderer 本身不是应被删除的 ReactNode adapter：它解决 Vue render 对动态 VNodeChild 与 cloneVNode 的真实需求。需修的是空状态组件目录持有共享 Renderer 和 Spin 重复实现。
